targets.name: Leaf-face roof carving
targets.concealment: The face is built from wood-colored leaf lobes and partly crossed by climbing ivy on matching timber.

targets.name: Wooden post owl
targets.concealment: The owl blends into the post grain, with ivy obscuring parts of the body and perch.

targets.name: Sleeping fox relief
targets.concealment: The fox is a shallow same-tone timber relief partly interrupted by ivy and door borders.

targets.name: Metal fountain bird
targets.concealment: The dark metal bird aligns with the fountain pipe and is crossed by stems among pale flowers.

targets.name: Small glass bell jar
targets.concealment: The clear jar shares window reflections and is partly crossed by ivy on the potting bench.

targets.name: Closed pocket watch
targets.concealment: The dull brass medallion rests against matching stone and is partially hidden by overhanging ivy.

targets.name: Small workshop clock
targets.concealment: The small round dial is recessed among golden gears, tools and reflected glass in the workshop.

targets.name: Hanging brass bell
targets.concealment: The small brass bell is tucked behind ivy fronds and repeated curved shelf brackets.

targets.name: Spotted shelf thrush
targets.concealment: Its mottled plumage matches the snowy stone and dried seeds, with ivy partly screening the feeding shelf.

targets.name: Small brass gear
targets.concealment: The small wheel is embedded among clock parts and partly behind the window sill and greenery.

targets.name: Frosted stone hare
targets.concealment: The weathered pale stone body and frost blend into its wall, with leaves obscuring parts of the feet.

targets.name: Galvanized watering can
targets.concealment: The large pale metal can stands openly under the bench.

targets.name: Garden tool basket
targets.concealment: The broad wicker basket and glove drape form a clear foreground anchor.

targets.name: Large terracotta planter
targets.concealment: The large decorated pot occupies a clear foreground corner.

targets.name: Glowing window lantern
targets.concealment: The bright hanging lantern is deliberately easy against the workshop window.
